status: 2026 experimental preprint; pure-water rate-parameter screening, not calibrated for Barth reactor salts or pH
reuse_note: Only a few attributed numerical rate parameters are transcribed for this audit; the paper and primary data archive are linked, not redistributed.
source_discrepancy: The abstract states 67.1 kJ/mol for the acid activation energy while Table 1 states 60.0 kJ/mol. This screen uses the detailed Table 1 value and reports the abstract value as a separate sensitivity, not a resolved correction.
kinetic_equation: d[HCN+CN-]/dt = -(k_acid[H+] + k_base[OH-])[HCN], with fast ideal HCN/CN- speciation at each reported step
limitations: Read-only right-endpoint quadrature; within-step arrival and pH changes are not resolved.
The published rate fit used formate accumulation as a proxy and assumes rapid subsequent formamide hydrolysis.
Rate-only ranges do not include pH, salt, transport, gas-source, or parameter-covariance uncertainty.
The calculation never injects hydrolysis products or changes the apparatus material or thermal ledger.
